headline: Dangote Reveals Public Infrastructure Shortfalls Inflated Obajana Cement Project to $1B
summary: Industrialist Aliko Dangote revealed that severe public infrastructure shortfalls inflated the initial $180 million estimate for his Obajana cement plant into a $1 billion venture.
why: Large-scale industrial developments in emerging markets reflect the capital expenditure impacts of local infrastructure deficiencies.

impacts.name: Cement & Construction
impacts.why: Public infrastructure shortfalls affected project costs for a major cement plant.
